name: Time Tribunal
source: Have you ever heard of the space-time continuum? Have you ever had the luck (or misfortune) to find yourself face to face with the laws of time? Two completely ordinary teenagers find themselves in an unequal mortal battle at a mysterious pioneer camp.
translation: 你聽說過時空連續體嗎？有沒有幸（或者說，不幸）親自領教過時間的法則？兩個再普通不過的少年在一座神秘的少年先鋒隊營地裡，被捲進了一場實力懸殊的生死較量。
